param_input_item.param_description: Example pattern, an integer matrix to learn from.
Use 'N' and 'seed' to configure the tile size and random seed.
Output size: a scalar (square) or a [rows cols] vector.
Seed of the pseudo-random generator (default 0). The same seed reproduces the same field.

param_output_item.param_description: The synthesized field, locally resembling the sample everywhere.
Diagnostics with success, retries, contradictions, maxEntropy and traceCount.
Collapse trace with row, column and remaining pattern count.

description.p: Synthesize a new field that looks everywhere locally like a small example, using the overlapping-model wave function collapse algorithm. All N-by-N patterns of the sample are learned with their overlap-compatibility rules, then the output is collapsed cell by cell with a lowest-entropy heuristic and constraint propagation, restarting on contradiction. A modern cornerstone of tile-based procedural content generation.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.
